decisions.summary: Per trial size the planted region = envelope less water less outside-command; its area is the acreage; each trial scored (illegal, acreage error) with fan_legal asked of the region's outline and the channels
decisions.why: FR-007 (acreage AND water legality scored on the region, no plots cut). Verified: tail_dangles reads only the plots' bounding box and flanks_commanded only the plots' vertex offsets across the fall (fit.py), both extents the region's outline carries; net_bends_acutely reads channels only. Round-1 item 2 resolved.

decisions.summary: Partition by row and column bunds per sector, wobble and wander kept, cells = polygonize of the noded union

Cells judged by ring_violations and the toe discipline; staircases split by the repair's own _split_steps; other violators merged across the longest shared bund whose union holds the rules, a merged staircase split in turn; a cell neither fixes is an SC-003 failure, never a reported leftover
decisions.why: FR-008 and US2 scenario 3 (merge or split, as the repair does today). Round-1 item 1 resolved: split restored, the reported residue removed. The final sentence is STRICTER than today's repair, whose third way (hold_ring_rules step 3) leaves an unfixable scrap bare, within SC-003's 0.5% bound; stricter is not a narrowing.

Harness computes the verdict: fastest of three back to back, totals, larger spread as the bar; SC-003 checks printed per input
decisions.why: SC-001, FR-004, FR-005, SC-003 as written.
